<function name="isentity" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns if the passed object is an <page>Entity</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="variable" type="any">The variable to check.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">True if the variable is an <page>Entity</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
